purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the existing full affiliate audit. Evidence only; this does not create a new queue task or UUID. Before adding these entries, the current main-branch tool dataset and latest queue state were checked, and no existing task IDs for these five tools were present in latest.json.

entries.commission: 25%-35% recurring revenue on referred customer transactions for up to 12 months
entries.payout_terms: Cash out at month-end via PayPal or Stripe; referral payments are verified and paid within 60 days after the referral starts a new trial
entries.eligibility: Official FAQ says the Partner Program is open to everyone; signup requires a few details and confirmation before a personal referral URL is issued
entries.evidence_summary: Current official Unbounce Partner Program confirms open signup, PartnerStack tracking, 25%-35% recurring commission for up to 12 months, a 90-day cookie, and PayPal/Stripe payouts.

entries.commission: Beginner tiers: 20% recurring for 12 months; expert tiers: 23%, 26%, or 30% recurring for 24 months depending on cumulative sales
entries.payout_terms: Current live affiliate page states monthly PayPal payouts with a $100 minimum and commissions paid 90 days after month-end; an older support article describes payout on request, so the live page is treated as fresher evidence and the discrepancy is preserved
entries.eligibility: Targets social media professionals, business coaches/consultants, educators, creators, SaaS reviewers and marketing-tool curators; no Vista Social customer account is required
entries.evidence_summary: Current official Vista Social affiliate page confirms instant dashboard access after registration, FirstPromoter tracking, a 90-day cookie, recurring commissions from 20% up to 30%, and PayPal payouts subject to a $100 threshold.

entries.network: Gravity Affiliate portal; current official materials reference PartnerStack in the affiliate FAQ/terms and Impact in the June 2026 Gravity Forms launch article, so provider naming is preserved as an unresolved official-source discrepancy
entries.commission: 20% base commission per referred sale, with high-performing affiliates eligible for up to 30%
entries.payout_terms: $10 minimum threshold; affiliates can choose a fixed payout date or balance threshold; official FAQ says payouts take about 8 weeks after the qualifying action depending on contract
entries.eligibility: Official June 2026 article says the program is open to everyone and applicants do not need to be Gravity Forms customers; applications are manually reviewed and typical approval time is 1-2 weeks
entries.evidence_summary: Current Gravity affiliate portal confirms an active program, 20%-30% per-sale commissions, 30-day cookie, $10 minimum payout threshold, and a live signup path. Network/provider naming differs across current first-party pages, so it is not guessed.

entries.commission: Up to 50% of eligible AliDropship solution sale price
entries.payout_terms: Commissions are approved 30 days after the end of the sale month and paid within the following 15 days; PayPal, Wise, or bank transfer; minimum payout $50 via PayPal and $1,000 via bank
entries.eligibility: Program targets ecommerce creators, educators, influencers, store owners, developers and freelancers; PPC advertisers and coupon/deal sites are not accepted; normal application review is stated as 3-4 business days
entries.evidence_summary: Current official AliDropship affiliate site confirms free signup, unique tracking links after approval, up to 50% commission, monthly payout processing, and explicit payout/eligibility restrictions. No current cookie duration was visible, so none is inferred.

entries.commission: Detailed current affiliate FAQ states 40% commission on the referred customer's first purchase; Dorik's partners page separately advertises up to 40% recurring commission, so the conflict is recorded rather than silently resolved
entries.payout_terms: Monthly bank-transfer payouts; $200 minimum threshold; commissions remain pending for 14 days and payouts are made by the 15th of the following month
entries.eligibility: Self-referrals, branded paid-search campaigns, spam/cookie stuffing, and coupon sites are prohibited
entries.evidence_summary: Current official Dorik affiliate page confirms a live signup path, 40% first-purchase commission language, 90-day cookie, monthly bank payouts and a $200 minimum. A contradictory 'recurring' marketing phrase on the partners page is preserved as an official-source discrepancy.
